name: Secrets Royal Beach Punta Cana
tagline: AAA Four Diamond · Bávaro Beach · Preferred Club for discerning lifestyle couples
best_for: Luxury lifestyle couples, romance, upscale beach scene
description: AAA Four Diamond beachfront adults-only resort on Bávaro Beach with 641 suites and the Unlimited-Luxury® concept. A consistent favourite among the lifestyle community for its Preferred Club tier (exclusive adults-within-adults amenities), beautiful beach, and notably open-minded, judgement-free atmosphere. Ranked #46 of 623 hotels in Punta Cana on TripAdvisor.
highlights: AAA Four Diamond — certified service standard guarantee
Ranked #46 of 623 hotels in Punta Cana (TripAdvisor)
641 all-suite property directly on Bávaro Beach
Preferred Club tier — exclusive pool, lounge, butler service
Strong Unlimited-Luxury® concept: 24hr room service, premium bar
22,854 TripAdvisor reviews — broad, reliable sentiment base
Hyatt Inclusive Collection — consistent standards across visits
considerations: Construction noise reported in some 2025 reviews
Premium pricing for Preferred Club can push total cost high
Not exclusively lifestyle-dedicated — general adults-only resort
Some service inconsistency noted in recent reviews
Can feel very large and impersonal during peak periods

reviews.name: Tara C
reviews.text: This is a beautiful location right on the beach and the facility is wonderful! The room has a bit of a funky, mildewy smell which I didn't like, but I don't know how easy it is to control that with the humidity there. Our 'tropical view' was literally a few bushes and a dirt road used by service vehicles. It was by no means a beautiful view. The food was just okay. Not great, not horrible. Blue Water Grill was the best restaurant we tried while we were there.

response.by: Roberto Iglesias, General Manager — Secrets Royal Beach Punta Cana
response.text: Dear Tara C, We appreciate you sharing your comments about your recent stay with us. We are happy to know that you found our property beautiful and enjoyed our facilities. We apologize for any inconvenience you experienced with your room, particularly regarding the humidity smell. Your feedback is truly valuable to us. Thank you as well for highlighting your experience with our food, and we are delighted to hear that you enjoyed Blue Water Grill. We look forward to welcoming you again and providing you with an even better experience in the future.

reviews.name: Craver1998
reviews.text: Overall we had a good time. It is a larger resort compared to what we usually travel to. We would have liked more staff being personable — some acted like they didn't care if we were there or not. The pool bar service was slow, with others getting waited on before us. However, many staff members made our trip better: Modesto in the buffet was amazing, Ruben was the best beach waiter ever, and Juan at the beach bar was a great bartender. The ribeye steak in the Bluewater grill was the best steak I have had in a while!

reviews.name: Ben W
reviews.text: Secrets Royal Beach was beyond our expectations. We had a Preferred Club room with a private pool. The room was beautiful and housekeeping was extremely attentive. Our personal butler Alberto went above and beyond to make our week relaxing and wonderful. The grounds are absolutely beautiful — every corner leads to another gorgeous garden or pool. The beach is expansive and immaculate. Preferred Club was very much worth the added expense, especially the Oceana breakfast with the ocean breeze blowing through.

response.by: Roberto Iglesias, General Manager — Secrets Royal Beach Punta Cana
response.text: Dear 875benw, Thank you for sharing your experience with us. We are delighted to know that you enjoyed your Preferred Club room as well as the services and facilities we offer. It is especially rewarding to hear your kind words about our staff, particularly Alberto. We apologize for any minor inconsistencies you experienced and look forward to welcoming you back for another exceptional stay.

reviews.name: Giles B
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay at Secrets Royal Beach and would love to return. One of the best parts was the staff — shout outs to housekeeper Lourdes Louis; Marlon 'Baby Chicken' Jacob at Oceana & Bordeaux; Gabrielle at Oceana and Himitsu; Julio the Preferred Club bartender; Charina the Oceana hostess; Gabriel the Lazy River gatekeeper; and Alberto our Butler. Only feedback: the BlueWater Grill had 8 large TVs showing mostly USA content — a missed opportunity to highlight Dominican history and culture.

response.by: Roberto Iglesias, General Manager — Secrets Royal Beach Punta Cana
response.text: Dear Giles B, We want to express our sincerest gratitude for sharing your experiences with us. We are thrilled to hear that you enjoyed our hospitality and that our employees provided exceptional service. We also appreciate your constructive feedback about the BlueWater Grill, which will help us improve and offer a more authentic experience for our guests. We look forward to welcoming you back.
